title: Deng Zhi Faces the Cauldron; Xu Sheng Burns a Fleet with Painted Walls
summary: Deng Zhi goes to Wu to propose that the two states who have just spent a year destroying each other should ally again. Sun Quan has a cauldron of oil heated to receive him; Deng Zhi walks up to it and laughs, and the alliance is remade and holds for forty years.

Cao Pi comes down to the river in person and finds the far bank fortified for hundreds of li — walls, battlements, spears. They are made of reed matting and paint, put up in one night, and by the time he works it out Xu Sheng's fireships are among his fleet.
history: The alliance is historical and was the single most consequential diplomatic act of the period. The painted walls are the novel's.

pins.note: Laughs at a cauldron of boiling oil, and remakes the alliance.
Fortifies a riverbank with reed matting and paint.
